derivation_boundary: Source claims verify terminology, mechanisms or techniques only. Each unit's geometry, placement, optional staging and tests are separately marked author proposals, not scientifically established cuteness recipes.

sources.title: Glocker et al. (2009), Baby Schema in Infant Faces
sources.supports: large-head/round-face/high-forehead/large-eye features and cuteness/caretaking ratings in manipulated infant photos
sources.claim_limit: Adult photographic body, identity and age changes are not established by this study.

sources.title: Nittono et al. (2012), The Power of Kawaii
sources.supports: cute animal-image exposure and task attention in the studied samples
sources.claim_limit: Does not prove that a particular pose, pastel palette or generated image is cute.

sources.title: Paul Ekman Group, Facial Action Coding System
sources.supports: anatomical description of visible facial movement
sources.claim_limit: Face movement is not sufficient evidence of real emotion, personality, intention or consent; no exact AU claims are added here.

sources.title: CLIP STUDIO / Art Rocket, Easy Steps to Creating Chibi Characters
sources.supports: illustrative two-to-four-head examples, simplified body/hand shapes, variable proportion preferences
sources.claim_limit: Chibi proportions are drawing choices, not biological age or a required change to an adult photo.

sources.title: Somerset House, CUTE exhibition
sources.supports: cuteness across art, fashion, toys, digital culture and unsettling combinations
sources.claim_limit: Exhibition taxonomy is not a quantitative cuteness classifier.

sources.title: Esaki Bisuko, Yami-kawaii origin and meaning
sources.supports: yume-kawaii plus dark/medical/violent/self-harm symbolic motifs; author explicitly distinguishes style preference from health state
sources.claim_limit: This is the creator's account; illustrated symbols do not establish a person's diagnosis, history or actions.

sources.title: Esaki Bisuko, Harajuku fashion dictionary
sources.supports: pastel-based fairy/yume and related fashion distinctions
sources.claim_limit: Not every pastel image is yume-kawaii, and no fixed costume is universally required.

sources.title: National Museum Foundation, heart pose stickers
sources.supports: named cheek-heart and two-hand-heart cultural-product usage
sources.claim_limit: Product examples support term use; hand topology still needs a declared variant and visible evidence.

sources.title: Unicode, crossed index finger and thumb proposal (2019)
sources.supports: crossed thumb/index form with Korean finger-heart usage and money/texture alternative meanings
sources.claim_limit: An emoji drawing is not a unique anatomical recipe, and the same hand shape does not prove affection.

sources.title: K.E.N-DIGIT, 100 hand-heart variants
sources.supports: many one-person hand-heart variants with separate practice material
sources.claim_limit: Variation existence verified; individual video variants were not all visually reviewed.

sources.title: Adobe, Shot size and angle
sources.supports: shot coverage separated from eye-level/high/low/top-down viewpoint definitions
sources.claim_limit: Viewpoint does not guarantee cuteness; Firefly setting support does not establish another runtime's capability.

sources.title: Adobe, Forced perspective
sources.supports: camera-depth arrangement and apparent scale relationships
sources.claim_limit: A large-looking object need not be physically large or actually touching another object.

sources.title: Adobe, Negative space photography
sources.supports: subject/environment empty-area relationships; space can have texture
sources.claim_limit: No universal empty-area threshold is made a runtime duty, and white background alone is insufficient.

sources.title: OM SYSTEM, High key photography
sources.supports: high-key treatment as photographic tonal organization
sources.claim_limit: High key, soft light, pastel color and overexposure remain separate concepts.

sources.title: Cambridge Dictionary, coy
sources.supports: reserved/feigned-shy and secretive contextual readings
sources.claim_limit: No fixed eyeline or erotic intention follows from this adjective.

sources.title: Merriam-Webster, coquettish / coquetry
sources.supports: coquettish as displaying coquetry; contextual flirtatious portrayal
sources.claim_limit: Definition does not prescribe a wink or prove the subject's desire or consent.

sources.title: TOKYO MX, Azato-kawaii drama introduction
sources.supports: self-aware charm used strategically by fictional characters
sources.claim_limit: Fictional motivation is a cultural example, not a real-person intent detector or compulsory pose.

sources.title: DreamV official, ribbon/back-opening top
sources.supports: brand usage of ero-kawaii with ribbon and sensual garment presentation
sources.claim_limit: Product evidence is one variant, not a universal rule to expose shoulders, change proportions or add this garment.

sources.title: TV TOKYO, 2011 kawaii compounds programme
sources.supports: separate kimo/busa/guro labels with mascot and organ-shaped-product examples
sources.claim_limit: Programme anecdotes are not representative population estimates or deterministic beauty judgments.

sources.title: Gloomy Bear official store
sources.supports: cute/creepy character-product coexistence and blood-drip motifs
sources.claim_limit: An example's branded identity, complete design or violent backstory is not imported into runtime candidates.

sources.title: Stavropoulos & Alba (2018), Cute Aggression
sources.supports: cute aggression as a viewer response with reward/emotion measures in the studied sample
sources.claim_limit: Does not require injury or contact, and a still facial expression alone cannot confirm the psychological state.

sources.title: National Institute of Korean Language, aegyo
sources.supports: aegyo as an attitude of appearing cute to others
sources.claim_limit: Does not mandate age, voice, sex, one facial configuration or another person's reaction.

sources.title: CLIP STUDIO TIPS, expression tutorial
sources.supports: illustrative facial components and expression design
sources.claim_limit: Tutorial rather than clinical affect evidence; individual cute translations in this package are author proposals.

sources.title: Photography studio Kasha, toothache pose
sources.supports: The studio describes one or both hands at the cheek as a named photography pose, with partial contour occlusion.
sources.claim_limit: Studio practice and marketing, not evidence of anatomical face-size change or universal appeal. Finger direction and exact contact are variant choices.

sources.title: Sandra Coan, Catchlights and light geometry
sources.supports: Catchlights are reflected specular patches in the eyes; shape and placement can carry lighting clues.
sources.claim_limit: The author aesthetic preference for upper catchlights is not universal law; a single reflection does not uniquely identify a full lighting setup.

sources.title: Adobe Camera Raw engineering, Inside Lens Blur
sources.supports: Separates depth of field, focus blur, motion blur and bokeh character; defocused point lights make bokeh shape conspicuous.
sources.claim_limit: This explanation does not establish cute emotion or current image-generator capability; bright bokeh circles are not required for all shallow-focus images.

sources.title: Nikon Professional Services, Point and area lighting
sources.supports: Large apparent light sources soften shadow boundaries; source direction and diffusion are separate lighting choices.
sources.claim_limit: Absolute modifier size alone is insufficient; relative size and distance matter. Soft light does not require high-key tones.

sources.title: ViVi own photo shoot, THE W collaboration
sources.supports: An own photo shoot labels a photographed pose gyaru peace and discusses coaching the pose.
sources.claim_limit: Confirms named usage in this shoot; exact finger and wrist geometry is not established by text alone. The source image has not been pixel-reviewed here.

sources.title: Stan Prokopenko / Art Rocket, Expressive hand poses
sources.supports: Constructs hands from palm masses, finger groups and individual finger paths.
sources.claim_limit: Drawing construction framework, not proof of every named gesture, social intention or cute effect.

sources.title: miyuli / CLIP STUDIO, Hand and foot structure
sources.supports: Explains finger origin, thumb direction, hand and foot articulation and shape construction.
sources.claim_limit: Anatomical drawing framework; does not define complete body poses or diagnose live anatomy from a pose.
